title: Tesla Stock (TSLA) Falls 1.3% to $398.50 (Nov 3)
summary: Tesla stock (TSLA) fell 1.32% to $398.50 on Nov 3 as the Nasdaq rose, with October China sales and the Fort Worth Robotaxi launch in focus.
body_markdown:
Elsewhere,[Nvidia (NVDA)](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/nvda/) gained 2.29% to $206.69 and fellow electric vehicle maker[Rivian (RIVN)](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/rivn/) rose 0.76% to $13.29. Tesla now sits 20.11% below its 52-week high of $498.83 and 34.00% above its 52-week low of $297.38.


## Why Tesla Stock Fell


No source we reviewed named a company-specific cause for Tuesday's drop, which came against a rising Nasdaq and gains in most large technology names. Three dated items were in view during the session.


First, according to[GuruFocus](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/teslas-china-made-vehicle-sales-182200130.html) , China Passenger Car Association (CPCA) data showed Tesla sold 67,829 China-made Model 3 and Model Y vehicles in October, up 10.3% from a year earlier. That was down 28.9% from September's 95,366 units, the Shanghai factory's best month of 2026, and the figures include exports as well as cars sold to Chinese buyers.


Second, GuruFocus reported that Robotaxi service expanded into Fort Worth, joining Austin, Dallas and Houston in Tesla's Texas network. The outlet noted the launch post left fleet size, pricing and whether the Dallas and Fort Worth service areas would connect unanswered.


Third, as reported by[Decrypt](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/crypto/articles/elon-musk-tesla-spacex-block-174615605.html) , an updated notice dated Monday, November 2, added Tesla and[SpaceX (SPCX)](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/spcx/) to the companies objecting to OKXICE TSV, a planned tokenized stock venue run as a 50-50 joint venture between NYSE owner Intercontinental Exchange and OKX's US holding company. Under the SEC's innovation exemption, a written objection within 30 days keeps that stock off the venue, and the objector count rose to 56.


## TSLA Stock Analysis: Supporting Factors and Risks


### Supporting Factors


- October was the 12th straight month of year-over-year growth in China-made sales, according to GuruFocus.
- Shanghai exports more than doubled to 361,972 vehicles from January to September, per GuruFocus, with South Korea taking roughly one fifth.
- With Fort Worth added, Robotaxi now serves four Texas cities, GuruFocus reported.


### Risks


- Tesla's 10.3% growth lagged the roughly 12% rise in industry-wide new energy passenger car wholesale sales in October, GuruFocus said.
- Domestic China deliveries fell 11.9% to 381,088 from January to September, per GuruFocus, so the headline Shanghai figure does not show domestic demand on its own.
- Without a disclosed fleet size or pricing, the revenue impact of the Fort Worth launch is hard to measure, GuruFocus noted.
